title: Business Office Calculation: Amount of the Fee-Waiver Adjustment on a Courtesy Rider Permit Fee (Student Transportation Services, 2026-27)
content:
**Definition.** The fee-waiver adjustment on a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit fee is the permit fee as posted times the waiver share of the meal status on file, less the meal-status waiver credits already on the fee, never below zero; times the adjustment months divided by the months the fee covers; less every billing correction already posted against the fee, never below zero; and never more than the fee net of every credit already against it. It is rounded half-up to the cent once, on the result.

The waiver share of the meal status on file is the reduced-price meal waiver share of the fee table, 50 percent.

## The quantities

- **Fee net of every credit already against it.** The permit fee less every credit entry posted against that fee: meal-status waiver, household cap, billing correction and any other credit linked to it.
- **Permit period.** 10 months for a school-year fee, running August through May; 5 months for a fall semester fee (August through December) or a spring semester fee (January through May). The period's first school day is August 12, 2026 for a school-year or fall semester fee and January 6, 2027 for a spring semester fee; its last day is May 31, 2027 for a school-year or spring semester fee and December 31, 2026 for a fall semester fee.
- **Months the fee covers.** All the months of the permit period for a fee posted before the period's first school day. For a school-year fee posted on or after that day, the whole calendar months from the month the fee posted through May, that month included. For any other fee posted on or after that day, the calendar days from the posting day to the period's last day, divided by the calendar days from the period's first school day to its last day, times the months of the permit period.
- **Fee's span.** From the later of the period's first school day and the posting day, to the period's last day.
- **Last day of the adjustment window.** The end date of an assignment in status ended or cancelled; otherwise the last day of the permit period (May 31, or December 31 for a fall semester fee).
- **Adjustment months.** The calendar days from the later of the day the status on file took effect and the start of the fee's span, to the last day of the adjustment window, divided by the calendar days of the fee's span, times the months the fee covers. They never exceed the months the fee covers.

A count of calendar days from one date to another is the number of days by which the later date follows the earlier: from August 12, 2026 to December 31, 2026 is 141 days.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A fall semester fee of 120.00 USD posted on July 20, carrying no waiver credit. A Reduced-Price Meal Status took effect on October 2; the assignment is active.

| Step of the definition | Figure |
|---|---|
| fee times the waiver share, less waiver credits already on the fee | 120.00 times 50 percent, less 0.00: 60.00 |
| months the fee covers (posted before August 12) | 5 |
| fee's span | August 12 to December 31: 141 days |
| adjustment months | 90 days (October 2 to December 31) divided by 141, times 5: 3.1915 |
| 60.00 times 3.1915 divided by 5 | 38.2979 |
| less billing corrections already posted (none), capped at the fee net of its credits (120.00) | 38.2979 |
| rounded half-up to the cent | 38.30 USD |
